strategy_roster.name: NonLagDot
strategy_roster.notes: NonLagDot is approximated by SMA(10); a long is the documented down-to-up turn of that average's slope and the opposite turn exits. Length=10 and StopLossPercent=1m are the documented values; the 1-hour candle type is not selectable here.

strategy_roster.name: Lego EA
strategy_roster.notes: Only parameter names are given, so the fast/slow MA crossover plus a directional filter is the retained core of the toggle-based Lego stack. CCI, stochastic, Accelerator, DeMarker and Awesome filters have no documented thresholds, and pip stops, MA shift and martingale lot recovery are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Three Breaky
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and high - low > 4 * atr(high,low,close,72)
strategy_roster.notes: Module 1 (ATR expansion) is translated on the current bar because shifted candles are unavailable; documented multipliers 4 and 72 are kept. Ichimoku span flips and the 20-candle max-body rule are not expressible, and the shared Parabolic SAR exit is approximated by the EMA(20) close; pip stops are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Market Slayer
strategy_roster.notes: ShortLength=10 and LongLength=20 are documented; the weighted averages are approximated by EMAs and the 4-hour SSL confirmation by a rising SMA(50) trend filter. Optional TakeProfitValue=20 / StopLossValue=50 are disabled by default and are pip-based, so both stops are null.

strategy_roster.name: Trendline Alert
strategy_roster.notes: The manually drawn Upper/Lower lines carry no values, so resistance and support are approximated by the prior 20-bar extremes. Breakout Points, StartHour/EndHour gating and the trailing stop in points are not expressible in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Volume Calculator
strategy_roster.notes: The docs state the strategy places no orders and only logs computed risk metrics from user-entered stop/target prices and Max Loss %, so there is no market-derived entry signal. The impossible negative-price guard is used instead of inventing one.

strategy_roster.name: Stochastic Exit Alerts
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic %K/%D is approximated by fast RSI(5) versus slow RSI(14) because no stochastic is whitelisted, with 30/70-style zones standing in for the oversold area. Only parameter names are documented, so the periods and zone levels are chosen defaults; tick-based stops are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: SAR Automated
strategy_roster.notes: Parabolic SAR is approximated by price position versus a 20-bar average plus a positive slope, since SarStep/SarMax cannot be reproduced. StopLoss, TakeProfit and TrailingStop are documented only as price-unit parameters with no values, so both percentage fields are null.

strategy_roster.name: Turnaround Tuesday
strategy_roster.notes: The signal is a calendar effect: buy Tuesday's open after a down Monday on 15-minute bars, which the DSL cannot express without date fields. The documented 2% stop is left null because the never-true guard produces no positions.

strategy_roster.name: The 950 Bar
strategy_roster.notes: This is a schedule-only EA that trades the direction of the 9:50 AM New York five-minute candle and uses no indicators, so no single-symbol market signal exists in the DSL. TargetTicks=150 / StopTicks=200 are tick offsets, not percentages, so both stop fields are null.
